list: Official 55-trophy list as published by PlayStation and tracked by PSNProfiles and Exophase (names, descriptions and grades match across both trackers). Guides below are written in my own words; each trophy names its sources beside the guide.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all yours, so there is no separate task to do for it. Play through the five story chapters, work the side questlines, then clear the 100% completion checklist in free-roam after the credits. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, with one playthrough enough and no online trophies at all, so the platinum is a long grind rather than a hard one.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Just play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and see it through to the end; the trophy pops when the mission completes. It is the first story trophy most players will earn, and no side task or collectible is needed for it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every main mission of Chapter 1; the trophy unlocks as the chapter closes and Chapter 2 begins. While you are still in Chapter 1, do the one thing that can be missed in the whole game: the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude). Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play through Chapter 2 to its end; the trophy pops when the chapter's final main mission is done. Chapter 2 is where duo free-roam opens up after the Coffee Break mission, so from here on you can switch between Jason and Lucia and start the partner trophies.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 3's main missions and the trophy unlocks as the story moves into Chapter 4. Several side questlines open during this chapter — Andy's (Lucia only), Randy's car wishlist, Tyrone's labs — so pick them up as they appear; they all stay available after the story, so nothing here can lock you out.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete Chapter 4 and the trophy pops at the chapter's close. Chapter 4 is also where the big bank-vault robberies open up through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which feeds the Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play trophies, so follow that thread when it appears.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, and the only gold tied to the main story. Finish the final mission of Chapter 5 and the trophy unlocks with the credits. After the story you keep free-roam of Leonida, the 100% completion checklist opens under Progress, and everything left for the platinum can be done without starting over.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run and the trophy pops at the end of it. There is nothing extra to do: just follow the mission objectives until the game marks it complete.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist; the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. Play it as the story presents it — no preparation or side progress changes anything about this one.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play and the trophy pops on completion. Like the other mission trophies, it comes from normal story play with no extra requirement.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners; the trophy unlocks when the mission wraps up. No side content gates it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown at the airport and the trophy pops at the mission's end. It is pure story progress, so just keep playing the main missions.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory and the trophy unlocks when it ends. This is the last of the mission-specific story trophies before the final mission itself.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the last one most players will earn. The 100% checklist opens after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but progress you made during the story already counts, and nothing on the list is missable. The requirements are forgiving: roughly 60% of true completion, not everything. You need any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied with binoculars, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, all robberies, all 8 large bank jobs, all 15 target decks, and 15 of 18 meditation spots. Most of it falls out naturally while chasing the other trophies; PowerPyx puts the whole platinum at about 200 hours with this checklist as the bulk of it.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: There are 397 stunts in Leonida, split into 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps, and you can mix categories freely to reach 250 — just doing the stunt once counts as completed. The quickest ones are the under-the-bridge flights, so a plane or helicopter tour of the bridges racks up the count fast. Track progress in the Progress menu under Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots. Note the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 for A Long Road.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts 9 activity types, viewable from the touchpad under Progress, then Activities. The set is fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race of some kind, and performing a stunt. Most of them are introduced by the story itself or marked with blue icons when you unfog the map, and you will tick nearly all of them off without trying while working on the other trophies. If one is left, open the Activities list, see which type shows zero, and do the easiest one of that type.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 12 shooting range locations holding 42 challenges between them, and every one of them needs a gold medal. The ranges open as you explore; work through each location's challenges one weapon at a time and use the range's own scoring feedback to learn the par times and accuracy targets. Golds here are not especially punishing, and range practice also raises your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy later. PowerPyx keeps a per-location guide to all 42 golds if a particular challenge stalls you.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations with 42 races between them, and you need a win at each of the 14 spots, not in every single race. Learn each course's corners once, then race cleanly rather than chasing risky shortcuts — a win is a win. The drone races also count toward the 100% checklist, so this trophy and A Long Road move together.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: There are 40 unique race locations around Leonida, and you need to win 20 different ones — repeats of the same race do not count twice. Pick the shorter, easier circuits first and use the fastest car you own for each surface. Your wins across race types all count, including Top Fun drone races, so the wins stack up while you chase the other racing trophies.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map, west of Key Lento. Go there, take the challenge, and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also ticks a box for Master of None, and catching fish raises Focus, which helps later combat trophies.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: There are 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home using the controllers, from Chapter 1 onward, and the fourth sits on arcade machines out in the world. To complete one, finish all of its levels at least once — you do not need its extra challenges. Pick whichever game you enjoy most and play it to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and opens automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. The chain runs through five quests — the Cellerichain climb, paying the Cellerica fee, the initiation, retrieving the van and the warehouse meet — and the trophy pops on the last one, Puff Puff Pass. Everything stays available after the story, so there is no rush and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline opens in Chapter 1, a while after the mission where you work for him; he calls you and gets a green KR marker in Key Lento. His quests are treasure dives: he marks purple chest icons for shipwrecks, you dive down, use the metal detector to dig the treasure off the ocean floor and bring it back. Seven shipwrecks in total close out the chain. He goes quiet for a stretch after Chapter 1, but he comes back in Chapters 2–3 — playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up — and the whole line stays open after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Five jobs make up the chain — checking out the mud club, two jobs with Billy, stealing the Impaler and the Hometown Heroes finale — and the trophy pops on the last one. All five stay available after the story, so finish them whenever you like.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers & Freaks are open-world side questlines, but only certain ones count — the big named questlines like Moses, Tyrone, Andy and Billy do not. Confirmed counters include Kirk's skunk-ape hunt, Kyle's farm errands, Yago's street-racing mentorship and Pilot Pete's delivery chain; each strand is several missions long. They all remain available in free-roam after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count, so check it before hunting for more.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, opens after the Chapter 3 mission where you steal the Zorrusso for him — that mission also unlocks the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars. Randy then wants 16 specific sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City; the game marks some for you, and scanning cars with the WAiNK app shows whether one is on the list. Deliver them in good condition for better pay, and the trophy pops on the final delivery. The whole list can be finished after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers for synthetic labs appear around Vice City; go to them and destroy them as part of the Take Out Kitty Litter quest. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone hands you the Spin On This finale, and the trophy pops when that is done. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE TROPHY THAT CAN BE MISSED. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and you can meditate as both Jason and Lucia at each one, which counts double. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The trap is in Chapter 1: at Jason's house, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow and accept. That session is gone for good once Chapter 1 ends, and PowerPyx, who earned the trophy after doing it, still cannot confirm whether it is required — so do it to be safe. The last spot only opens once you can play both characters together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, so this trophy is the only reason the Chapter 1 meditation matters.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. His chain is about hunting specific animals he requests — he marks hunting spots with purple icons, and you bring the animals back to him as Jason. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. One clean shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required. His 15 target decks are also needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy and A Long Road progress together.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are scattered around Leonida in sets, and you need to finish any 3 complete sets for this silver. Cards are a pure exploration collectible: sweep each region as you unfog the map, check the collectible tracker to see which sets are close to complete, and finish the sets with the fewest cards missing first. PowerPyx maps all 18 card set locations if you want to hunt them down systematically rather than stumbling on them.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: WAiNK scans are objects in the world you scan by holding up on the D-pad and then R1. There are far more than 100 of them — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — so it does not matter which 100 you scan. Just scan everything you pass while playing: the app is also how you discover vehicles for Whip It Good, so the two trophies climb together. A busy walk through Vice City with the scanner out is the fastest way to close the gap if you are short at the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, and you need any 50 of them. Track them under Progress, then Challenges — each one shows a checkmark when done. Most complete themselves while you chase the other trophies and the 100% checklist, which needs 70 of 80, so this trophy will usually pop on its own along the way. If it is one of your last, look at the list and pick the ten easiest unfinished ones rather than grinding a hard one.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You need your partner beside you, which is only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break unlocks duo free-roam — call them with right on the D-pad plus Triangle. Then build a 4-star wanted level by causing chaos, and escape the red heat zone entirely. The easiest escape is a fast sports bike cutting through traffic, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a known safe route: police struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you there. The trophy pops once you are out of the heat zone, not just the flashing search area. It also comes naturally during the bank-vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Again you need your partner with you, so this only works after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. With the wanted level active, hit three robbery targets in a row — green icons on the map — without the wanted level dropping. Wear an armored vest, carry sticky bombs and healing items, and keep moving between shops. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, which open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3: rob a couple of items in each, crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and if the police arrive before you finish a store, hit a fourth shop — the unlock is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Leonida has 557 vehicles at launch — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes — and you need to discover any 100. Open the WAiNK app on your phone, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it; scanning is enough, you never have to drive it. The fastest method is standing on a busy road and scanning everything that passes. The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models scanned, so this trophy arrives automatically on the road to A Long Road. Check your totals under the touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is triggered with L3 plus R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar in the top-left of the screen. You must drop 5 enemies inside one activation, so prepare first — eat or drink to buff focus, use Adrenaline to stretch the slowdown, wear body armor, and line up a group of enemies before you trigger it. Gang operations are a good stage, since several enemies stand close together; an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556 works better than a pistol here. Note it does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it has to be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not the planes sitting out on the airfield. The easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge and walk straight into the plane, then go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse onto the strip and take off. Fly at least 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops, slightly delayed. You can also enter through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — drive in through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance. Climb into a Rhino, fire at the soldiers who come for you, and the trophy unlocks once you have used it. Expect a heavy military response, so do not plan a long drive afterwards; the trophy is the point, not the getaway.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Go to a store's back door and use the Snap Gun instead of kicking it — the kick sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave; the trophy pops shortly after you are out. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first attempt.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which is marked from story progress: you tail a security van to a bank, a guard carries a briefcase of cash in, the vault opens, and you slip in and grab it — bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the cash alone and have to hand off a bag. After that, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 a tip (after his earlier Payday Loans quests), marking vans with purple icons to follow to the next bank. Each robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to shake the heat. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this silver comes automatically on the way to A Long Road, paying up to $205,000 per bank.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically during the same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing the truck. You can also get it earlier — armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks, so block one's path, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius before the trophy registers. Sticky bombs are found in the back of Yasmani's shop once his quests are done, and Yasmani becomes your fence from Chapter 3's jewelry jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: You need to fully unfog the whole map — every blacked-out patch revealed. The fastest way is by plane: fly over each fogged area until the map fills in, working region by region so you do not miss a corner of the Keys or the northern counties. This is worth doing early anyway, since unfogging marks activities, races and collectibles that feed half the other trophies.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs running 39 illegal operations across Leonida, and you only need one operation per gang for this trophy — the 100% checklist needs all 39, so it comes automatically on the road to A Long Road. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically by story progress. Track your count per gang under Progress, then Gangs: scroll over a gang and the bottom-right shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar. That is the whole trophy — a small scenic moment, no mission or purchase chain attached. If it does not pop immediately, stay at the bar until the drink animation finishes.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: This needs one specific car from one specific showroom: the blue Banshee in the showroom in the south of Vice City. You can only take it after you get the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs — hack into the Banshee, then drive forward straight through the showroom window. The trophy pops a little after you are out on the street. No other car works; it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: This trophy is about Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. During the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling you are sent there anyway: inside, steal all 3 key valuables — the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs bought from Ammu-Nation. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and killing the enemies inside is optional. If you miss one valuable, do not worry: the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can go back for whatever is left.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: You need maximum strength on both Jason and Lucia at the same time — check it under the touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then Strength, the heart icon. This only becomes possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between the two. Buy a gym membership and always train with both characters together: call your partner with right on the D-pad plus Triangle, and while one of you works out, the other trains automatically, so you make double progress. Fitness clubs are filterable on the map under Activities, and there are plenty across Vice City; you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: You need 500 actions that shift your criminal profile, and the trophy list itself shows your count — tap the trophy to see it. Turn on criminal profile notifications in Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, and a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something counts. The profile runs from Professional (stealthy jobs, clean escapes, destroyed evidence) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho and the permanent Irredeemable, and almost everything you do — robberies, fights, escapes — adds to the total. It will almost certainly pop on its own while you finish the other trophies; if it is your last, the fastest farm is running over civilians and police with a car, though at Psycho or Irredeemable the police shoot on sight.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be connected to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, possibly robbing it a second time in a particular way; the store sits in Little Cuba, Vice City. No guide had pinned it down by launch week, so treat any method you see online as a guess until a second source confirms it. Practical advice: keep a manual save from before you first rob Payday Loans, avoid burning your one shot at it, and check back once the guide sites update — this entry will be revised when the method is confirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: This is the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — the spawn is a little random, so if it is not there, drive away and come back. When the car is there, follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light in the sky, and the UFO drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. The trick is the crowd, not the bike: find a packed stretch like Ocean Beach or a busy Vice City street, build a little speed, and kick pedestrians as you pass them without stopping. Ten in a minute is generous once you are in a crowd, and the timer is the only pressure.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew — that unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, take the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most), and repeat until $250,000 has passed through fences in total; it does not need to be in one trip. The bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 each, but they only open after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, so this trophy builds naturally while you clear the robbery trophies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Simply spend $100,000 in total across every kind of shop — it is cumulative, not one purchase. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns and ammo at Ammu-Nation, car mods, and tattoos. There are dozens of each shop type across Leonida — 24 gun stores, 67 clothing stores, 14 mod shops and more — so normal play spends a good chunk of it. If you are close at the end, buy a few high-end weapon attachments rather than cheap consumables.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: There are 12 garages in total, 4 of them story-related and 8 purchasable — you only need the 8 you can buy, for $160,000 all together. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone; buy them through that app. Robberies are the quickest money-maker, especially the higher-value jobs in Chapters 3 and 4. Garages also matter for On the Spot, since each one adds parking spots for registered vehicles.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses. It lets you register stolen vehicles so they can be delivered to you anywhere — but you need parking spots first, so buy garages (see Little Boxes), since each garage adds one or more spots. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and then Register in his garage. Early on he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
